intent: Pre-landing diff review: judges the change against its acceptance contract (Conformance lens) as an independent second actor, then reviews in a fixed priority order (Conformance → Security → Performance → Correctness → Maintainability → Testing), auto-fixes only behaviour-preserving issues and flags the rest, hard-gates on conformance and security findings, and records a 04-review.md artifact.

dimensions.name: conformance-gate
dimensions.criterion: Judges the change against its acceptance contract: re-derives the criteria independently, verifies the conformance matrix with lib/acceptance-verify.ts, audits the cited tests, and hard-gates on any unmet criterion — not trusting the build's own green suite.

dimensions.name: priority-order
dimensions.criterion: Reviews in the fixed order: Conformance → Security → Performance → Correctness → Maintainability → Testing.

dimensions.name: security-hard-gate
dimensions.criterion: An unresolved security finding is a hard gate; /ship does not proceed past it.

dimensions.name: auto-fix-safe-only
dimensions.criterion: Auto-fixes only behaviour-preserving changes; flags anything that alters design/behaviour.

dimensions.name: performance-antipatterns
dimensions.criterion: The Performance lens screens the change against the named cloud performance antipatterns (No Caching, Chatty I/O, Retry Storm, …), each with its fix.

dimensions.name: diff-scoped
dimensions.criterion: Reviews the diff against the base, not the whole repo.

dimensions.name: records-artifact
dimensions.criterion: Records the report as the 04-review.md run artifact (not 03, which collides with builds).
